name: Quick Review
description: Run an independent review of the latest conversation.

permissions.reason: Identifies the active chat to review.
Reads the latest 10 messages as review context.
Detects and clears the executed /review command from the composer.
Places a user-approved revision prompt in the main composer without sending it.
Stores completed reviews in the chat they were produced in, so the chat's review history persists across chat switching.
Shows concise progress and error notifications.
Opens the persistent review pane that lists, sends, and deletes the chat's reviews without adding chat messages.
Keeps the always-visible Review launcher in the title bar so the pane is one click or mod+shift+r away in any chat.
Optionally adds a persistent Review workspace launcher that opens the same review pane; /review still works when unavailable.
Re-scopes the open pane to the chat that is now open when the user switches chats: the frame re-reads the active chat id on the host's own event stream.

commands.name: review
commands.label: Quick Review
commands.description: Review the latest 10 messages and open the review pane.

commands.label: Show host diagnostics
commands.description: Report the live host contract: API compatibility, permissions, surfaces, features, storage quotas, trust level, and reviewer model assignment status.

popups.title: Quick Review
popups.description: Independent review history for the active chat.

titleBarItems.title: Quick Review
titleBarItems.label: Quick Review
titleBarItems.description: Open or close the review pane.

modelAssignments.label: Review model
modelAssignments.description: Optional independent model for /review. If unset, Quick Review uses the main model.
